subject.title: Cloud-worker reclaim drops worker-authored Git commits

question: Should the cloud-worker subsystem adopt verified worker-authored commits during reclaim, including durable Git HEAD/index recovery, rather than continue returning their file contents as ordinary working-tree changes?
rationale: The report identifies a concrete correctness gap, but accepting the Git object-transfer, ancestry-validation, and crash-recovery contract requires owner confirmation after direct review of the current cloud-worker implementation.

options.title: Sponsor Git-aware reclaim
options.body: Confirm the proposed verified commit-import and atomic adoption contract, then assign or implement a focused repair with recovery coverage.

options.title: Preserve file-only reclaim
options.body: Keep the present behavior only if maintainers explicitly define worker commits as unsupported and update the documented contract and worker behavior accordingly.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Git-aware reclaim
recommendation.body: Confirm the proposed verified commit-import and atomic adoption contract, then assign or implement a focused repair with recovery coverage.
